headline: Healthcare that takes time to *listen*.
lede: Premier Wellness Telehealth provides compassionate, HIPAA-compliant virtual care for adults across Arizona, Florida, Virginia, and Washington — convenient, personalized care from the comfort and privacy of your home.
bio:
Lissette Moody is a nurse practitioner who holds a Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) degree and is board certified as an adult nurse practitioner by the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board. She is the founder of Premier Wellness Telehealth. A registered nurse since 2006 and a nurse practitioner for 15 years, she has cared for adults in primary care, transitional care, and inpatient settings, with experience in women's health and a focus on preventive health, chronic condition support, and comprehensive wellness assessments.

She founded Premier Wellness Telehealth to give adults convenient access to thoughtful, personalized care, without the time pressure of traditional healthcare settings.

Her approach centers on listening carefully, explaining recommendations clearly, and involving patients in decisions about their health. For patients who want ongoing support, she is available to continue care over time, so they don't have to start over at every visit.

Licensed in: Arizona, Florida, Virginia, and Washington State. Patients must be located in one of these states at the time of their visit.
